holds.reason: The exact-form search found this notice and the near form Shimon son of Yosani. The checked Pesikta supplies the latter form, not direct evidence for identifying the two fathers. Retain this local kinship statement and its rare spelling.

evidence.witness: Pesikta de Rav Kahana according to an Oxford manuscript, Dov Mandelbaum ed., N.Y. 1987
